description: Open positions of a company that hires through Breezy HR, from its public career-site feed: job title, department, employment type, location(s) with country, remote flag and remote policy, salary text when published, published date and apply URL. Give the company's Breezy subdomain (the part before .breezy.hr). Optional keyword and remote-only filters. Related tools on this server, for a different need: jobs_ashby when you need open roles from one company's public Ashby job board; jobs_greenhouse when you need open roles from one company's public Greenhouse job board. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

company.description: Breezy subdomain, e.g. remote for remote.breezy.hr (required)

q.description: Optional keyword matched against title and department
